items.html: It has already been explained above that the primary coupling is in Arich Anpin; but it was also necessary for Aba and Ima, who are higher than ZON, to couple, and their formation had to come about through them. The matter is this: it was explained above, at the beginning of this chapter, the matter of the clothing of all the Partzufim, and how ZON, being in the phase of three included in three, were placed in the middle, between the NHY of Arich Anpin and Aba and Ima.
